tray.showHide: System tray menu item: shows the window, or hides it when it is visible. Plain text, no placeholders.
tray.playPause: System tray menu item: toggles playback.
tray.next: System tray menu item: next track.
tray.previous: System tray menu item: previous track.
tray.quit: System tray menu item: exits the app.
taskbar.previous: Tooltip of the Windows taskbar preview's previous-track button.
taskbar.play: Tooltip of the taskbar preview's play button (verb).
taskbar.pause: Tooltip of the taskbar preview's pause button (verb).
taskbar.next: Tooltip of the taskbar preview's next-track button.
